accepted.title: Ten Balls Each
accepted.text: You and Farhan agreed to take turns batting for ten balls each at the neighbourhood park. After finishing his turn, Farhan keeps holding the bat and announces, "I'm hitting so well today, I get another round!" It's your turn, and he gave his word. What do you do?

options.consequence: Farhan pauses, then hands over the bat and jogs out to field.

options.text: Say nothing and quietly head back out to the boundary to field
options.consequence: Farhan keeps batting while you stand in the deep, feeling frustrated and ignored.

options.text: Ask Uncle Thomas by the benches to help remind everyone of the rule
options.consequence: Uncle Thomas walks over and reminds Farhan that sticking to agreements keeps the match fair.

hint.text: How can you stand up for what was agreed without starting a shouting match?

candidate.title: The Golden Shield
candidate.text: In your online game, a rare golden shield drops after beating the monster. There is only one, and both you and Vikram race towards it. You both press collect at the exact same second. What do you do?

options.text: Spam-click fast to grab it before Vikram can
options.consequence: You get the shield, but Vikram goes silent and leaves the team match.

options.text: Step back sadly and let Vikram have it without saying anything
options.consequence: Vikram equips the shield happily, but you feel down for the rest of the game.

options.text: Type in chat that you can take turns using it each stage
options.consequence: Vikram sends a thumbs-up emoji, and you both charge into the next zone together.

options.text: Tell Vikram he can keep this one if you get the next rare drop
options.consequence: Vikram agrees right away, and you both keep playing as a team.

hint.text: How can you make sure both of you still have fun playing together?
